| Port | Shape | Axes | Domain | Role | Presence | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `output` | `[feature: project_to]` | [model.feature](#axis-model.feature) (feature) | inherit (self) | [activation.embedding](#role-activation.embedding) | always | The embedding.<br>*Note: granularity is carried by the public OUTPUT, not by the primitive* |

##### Parameters

| Slot | Role | Shape | Axes | Sharing | Presence / multiplicity | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `weight` | [pooler.projection](#role-pooler.projection) | `[feature: project_to] × [feature: width]` | [model.feature](#axis-model.feature) (feature) × [model.width](#axis-model.width) (feature) | exclusive | always | The projection, `project_to × width`. |

##### State ports

None: this primitive carries no state. Only a sequence operator does (§4.1).

##### Effects

- Reads: `input`
- Writes: `output`

##### Semantic partitions

| Target | Communication | When | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| axis [model.width](#axis-model.width) (argument) | all_gather | always | Column-parallel over the projection's output features. |

<a id="contract-splice-1.0.0" name="contract-splice-1.0.0"></a>

#### `splice@1.0.0`

*data/catalog/contracts/splice/1.0.0.json*

**Inserts an already-projected stream into the token sequence.**

Tags: [`multimodal`](#tag-multimodal)

Both inputs are in the token domain at `width`: `text` is the embedded token sequence, `source` a stream already projected to `width` (image patches, audio frames). The output is the token sequence with the stream spliced in at its placeholder positions. No parameter, no state.

> **Note (maintainers).** Insertion of an already projected stream into the token sequence.

| Arguments | Inputs | Outputs | Parameters | Constants | State ports | Partitions | Logical cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (1 required, 1 structural) | 2 | 1 | 0 | 0 | none | 1 | — |

##### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Structural | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `width` | cardinality | yes |  | yes | Feature width of the token stream. |

##### Ports

Inputs:

| Port | Shape | Axes | Domain | Role | Presence | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `[feature: width]` | [model.width](#axis-model.width) (feature) | token (self) | [activation.hidden](#role-activation.hidden) | always | Embedded token sequence. |
| `source` | `[feature: width]` | [model.width](#axis-model.width) (feature) | token (self) | [activation.hidden](#role-activation.hidden) | always | Projected stream to insert. |

Outputs:

| Port | Shape | Axes | Domain | Role | Presence | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `output` | `[feature: width]` | [model.width](#axis-model.width) (feature) | token (self) | [activation.hidden](#role-activation.hidden) | always | Token sequence with the stream inserted. |

##### Parameters

This primitive owns no learned tensor.

##### State ports

None: this primitive carries no state. Only a sequence operator does (§4.1).

##### Effects

- Reads: `source`, `text`
- Writes: `output`

##### Semantic partitions

| Target | Communication | When | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| any axis (elementwise) | none | always | Elementwise placement: any axis, no communication. |

##### Domain transforms

| From port | To port | Relation | Factor | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | `output` | insert | — | The elements arriving on `source` are inserted into the token stream of `text`, which the output keeps. |

<a id="axes" name="axes"></a>

## Axes

An axis names a dimension. Shapes unify by axis identity (V4): the same extent on two different axes is two different things. `value` axes index tensors; `instance` axes key state instances (session, branch).

| Axis | Space | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="axis-attention.head_dim"></a>`attention.head_dim` | value | Dimension of one attention head. |
| <a id="axis-attention.head_group"></a>`attention.head_group` | value | A group of heads of a grouped output projection: `heads * head_dim / o_groups` channels. |
| <a id="axis-attention.heads"></a>`attention.heads` | value | Query heads; also the flattened `heads * head_dim` projection width. |
| <a id="axis-attention.index_dim"></a>`attention.index_dim` | value | Dimension of one sparse-index head and of a cached index key. |
| <a id="axis-attention.index_heads"></a>`attention.index_heads` | value | Heads of the sparse index. |
| <a id="axis-attention.kv_heads"></a>`attention.kv_heads` | value | Key/value heads; the head axis of a KV cache. |
| <a id="axis-attention.o_groups"></a>`attention.o_groups` | value | Groups of the low-rank output projection. |
| <a id="axis-attention.o_rank"></a>`attention.o_rank` | value | Rank of one output group; flattened as `o_groups * o_rank`. |
| <a id="axis-attention.q_rank"></a>`attention.q_rank` | value | Rank of the query bottleneck of latent attention. |
| <a id="axis-attention.qkv_flat"></a>`attention.qkv_flat` | value | Fused query/key/value projection width.<br>*Note: fused QKV width; under GQA this is not an exact product, hence no factors* |
| <a id="axis-attention.query_gate"></a>`attention.query_gate` | value | Which rows of a gated query projection, per head: the query rows, then the gate rows. |
| <a id="axis-audio.kernel"></a>`audio.kernel` | value | Support of a temporal convolution, in frames.<br>*Note: support of a temporal convolution* |
| <a id="axis-audio.mels"></a>`audio.mels` | value | Mel bins of a spectrogram frame. |
| <a id="axis-conditioning.feature"></a>`conditioning.feature` | value | Width of a conditioning vector: per-layer inputs and their projections. |
| <a id="axis-deltanet.conv_width"></a>`deltanet.conv_width` | value | Channels of the causal convolution of a gated-delta layer. |
| <a id="axis-deltanet.head_dim"></a>`deltanet.head_dim` | value | Dimension of one gated-delta head; the state matrix is `head_dim × head_dim`. |
| <a id="axis-deltanet.value_dim"></a>`deltanet.value_dim` | value | Flattened value width of a gated-delta layer, `value_heads * head_dim`. |
| <a id="axis-deltanet.value_heads"></a>`deltanet.value_heads` | value | Value heads of a gated-delta layer; one state matrix each. |
| <a id="axis-ffn.gate_flat"></a>`ffn.gate_flat` | value | Fused gate and up projection width, `2 * inner`.<br>*Note: fused gate and up: exact product projection x inner, hence factors* |
| <a id="axis-ffn.inner"></a>`ffn.inner` | value | Inner width of a feed-forward network. |
| <a id="axis-ffn.projection"></a>`ffn.projection` | value | Which projection within a fused axis: gate or up; query, key or value. |
| <a id="axis-instance.branch"></a>`instance.branch` | instance | Instance key: a branch of a session, a fork of the sequence. |
| <a id="axis-instance.session"></a>`instance.session` | instance | Instance key: a session, one sequence being served. |
| <a id="axis-model.feature"></a>`model.feature` | value | Feature axis of an output projection that is not the model width, such as a pooler's embedding.<br>*Note: feature axis of an output projection* |
| <a id="axis-model.layer"></a>`model.layer` | value | Structural position of a layer within a stack.<br>*Note: structural position of a layer within a stack* |
| <a id="axis-model.vocabulary"></a>`model.vocabulary` | value | Token identifiers of a vocabulary. |
| <a id="axis-model.width"></a>`model.width` | value | Model width d: the feature dimension of the residual stream.<br>*Note: model width (d)* |
| <a id="axis-moe.experts"></a>`moe.experts` | value | Routed experts of a mixture of experts. |
| <a id="axis-residual.rank"></a>`residual.rank` | value | Rank of a low-rank residual branch (LAuReL). |
| <a id="axis-residual.stream"></a>`residual.stream` | value | Parallel residual streams (AltUp, hyper-connections). |
| <a id="axis-sequence.compression"></a>`sequence.compression` | value | Positions folded into one compressed cache entry. |
| <a id="axis-sequence.position"></a>`sequence.position` | value | A learned position, or one slot of position history.<br>*Note: learned position within a sequence* |
| <a id="axis-token.type"></a>`token.type` | value | Segment type of an encoder with segment embeddings.<br>*Note: segment type of an encoder with segment embeddings* |
| <a id="axis-vision.channels"></a>`vision.channels` | value | Image channels. |
| <a id="axis-vision.merged_patch"></a>`vision.merged_patch` | value | Concatenation of the patches merged into one token.<br>*Note: patches merged by spatial_merge_size**2* |
| <a id="axis-vision.patch"></a>`vision.patch` | value | Patch side, in pixels. |

### Details

**`attention.qkv_flat`**

Under grouped-query attention `(heads + 2*kv_heads) * head_dim` is not a product of declared axes, so the axis carries no factors and the shape alone does not say how to partition it by head (O5.10).

**`ffn.gate_flat`**

An exact product of the `ffn.projection` and `ffn.inner` axes, hence declared factors: the fused axis can be partitioned along `inner`.

**`instance.branch`**

An `instance` axis keys state allocations rather than tensor elements: two branches of one session own distinct state instances, and a state binding says whether they may share.

**`model.width`**

Every primitive that reads or writes the residual stream declares its `input` and `output` shape on this axis. Shapes unify by axis identity (V4): two ports of extent `width` on `model.width` are compatible, the same extent on another axis is not.

<a id="precision-roles" name="precision-roles"></a>

## Precision roles

A precision role bounds the storage types a slot, port or state component may take. A model that selects a dtype outside the admissible set is refused (V14); a model that selects none gets the default.

| Role | Admissible | Default | Sensitivity | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="role-activation.audio_frames"></a>`activation.audio_frames` | `f32`, `f16` | `f32` | reduced | Mel-spectrogram input frames. |
| <a id="role-activation.embedding"></a>`activation.embedding` | `f32`, `bf16` | `f32` | reduced | Output embedding of a pooling head. |
| <a id="role-activation.hidden"></a>`activation.hidden` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3` | `bf16` | reduced | Hidden activations: the residual stream and the values between primitives. |
| <a id="role-activation.logits"></a>`activation.logits` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `f32` | reduced | Output logits. |
| <a id="role-activation.pixels"></a>`activation.pixels` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `f32` | reduced | Image pixels at the input of a patch embedding. |
| <a id="role-activation.token_index"></a>`activation.token_index` | `i32`, `i64` | `i32` | full_precision | Token identifiers: integers by semantics, not by storage choice.<br>*Note: vocabulary identifier: an integer by semantics, not by storage choice* |
| <a id="role-attention.compressor"></a>`attention.compressor` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Compressor projections and position tables of latent attention. |
| <a id="role-attention.indexer"></a>`attention.indexer` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Projections of the sparse index of latent attention. |
| <a id="role-attention.kv_projection"></a>`attention.kv_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Latent key/value projection. |
| <a id="role-attention.output_down"></a>`attention.output_down` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Down projection of a grouped low-rank attention output. |
| <a id="role-attention.output_gate"></a>`attention.output_gate` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Per-head output gate projection. |
| <a id="role-attention.output_projection"></a>`attention.output_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Attention output projection. |
| <a id="role-attention.output_up"></a>`attention.output_up` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Up projection of a grouped low-rank attention output. |
| <a id="role-attention.projection_bias"></a>`attention.projection_bias` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Biases of the attention projections. |
| <a id="role-attention.qkv_projection"></a>`attention.qkv_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Fused query/key/value projection. |
| <a id="role-attention.query_down"></a>`attention.query_down` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Query down projection of latent attention. |
| <a id="role-attention.query_up"></a>`attention.query_up` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Query up projection of latent attention. |
| <a id="role-attention.sink"></a>`attention.sink` | `f32`, `bf16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Per-head attention sink logits.<br>*Note: one scalar per head; its sensitivity is numerical, not storage* |
| <a id="role-conditioning.feature"></a>`conditioning.feature` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Gate and projection of per-layer conditioning, and the per-layer projection of an embedding. |
| <a id="role-conditioning.projection"></a>`conditioning.projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Conditioning projector of a feed-forward network. |
| <a id="role-deltanet.convolution"></a>`deltanet.convolution` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Causal convolution kernel of a gated-delta layer. |
| <a id="role-deltanet.decay_projection"></a>`deltanet.decay_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Decay and update-strength projections of a gated-delta layer. |
| <a id="role-deltanet.gate_projection"></a>`deltanet.gate_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Output gate projection of a gated-delta layer. |
| <a id="role-deltanet.output_projection"></a>`deltanet.output_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Output projection of a gated-delta layer. |
| <a id="role-deltanet.qkv_projection"></a>`deltanet.qkv_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Fused query/key/value projection of a gated-delta layer. |
| <a id="role-deltanet.scalar"></a>`deltanet.scalar` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Per-head scalars of a gated-delta layer: decay bias and log rate. |
| <a id="role-embedding.bias"></a>`embedding.bias` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Bias of a patch embedding. |
| <a id="role-embedding.position"></a>`embedding.position` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Learned position tables. |
| <a id="role-embedding.projection"></a>`embedding.projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Patch projection of a patch embedding. |
| <a id="role-embedding.table"></a>`embedding.table` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Token embedding tables, and the output heads tied to them. |
| <a id="role-embedding.token_type"></a>`embedding.token_type` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Segment-type embedding table. |
| <a id="role-ffn.down_projection"></a>`ffn.down_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Down projection of a feed-forward network or expert. |
| <a id="role-ffn.gate_projection"></a>`ffn.gate_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Gate projection of a feed-forward network or shared expert. |
| <a id="role-ffn.projection_bias"></a>`ffn.projection_bias` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Biases of feed-forward projections. |
| <a id="role-ffn.up_projection"></a>`ffn.up_projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Up projection of a feed-forward network or shared expert; the fused gate and up projection of a routed expert. |
| <a id="role-frontend.bias"></a>`frontend.bias` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Biases of the audio front-end convolutions. |
| <a id="role-frontend.convolution"></a>`frontend.convolution` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | reduced | Kernels of the audio front-end convolutions. |

| <a id="role-moe.router"></a>`moe.router` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Routing projection of a mixture of experts.<br>*Note: routing logits decide WHICH expert is chosen: the sensitivity is on ACCUMULATION (§9.4), not on storage. bf16 stored + f32 accumulated is common practice.* |
| <a id="role-moe.score_bias"></a>`moe.score_bias` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Per-expert routing score bias. |
| <a id="role-moe.shared_gate"></a>`moe.shared_gate` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Gate projection of the shared experts. |
| <a id="role-mtp.projection"></a>`mtp.projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Multi-token prediction projections. |
| <a id="role-norm.bias"></a>`norm.bias` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Bias of a layer normalization. |
| <a id="role-norm.scale"></a>`norm.scale` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Scale of a normalization.<br>*Note: a quantized normalization scale shifts the whole layer* |
| <a id="role-pooler.projection"></a>`pooler.projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Projection of a pooling head. |
| <a id="role-projector.bias"></a>`projector.bias` | `f32`, `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Biases of a vision-language projector. |
| <a id="role-projector.patch_merger"></a>`projector.patch_merger` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Patch-mixing matrix of a vision-language projector. |
| <a id="role-projector.projection"></a>`projector.projection` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Projections of a vision-language or audio-language projector. |
| <a id="role-residual.hyper_connection"></a>`residual.hyper_connection` | `f32`, `bf16` | `bf16` | full_precision | Mixing coefficients of hyper-connections. |
| <a id="role-residual.low_rank"></a>`residual.low_rank` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Low-rank projections of a LAuReL branch. |
| <a id="role-residual.stream"></a>`residual.stream` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f32`, `f8e4m3`, `fp4` | `bf16` | quantizable | Projections and coefficients of AltUp streams. |
| <a id="role-state.conv"></a>`state.conv` | `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | quantizable | Convolution history state. |
| <a id="role-state.index"></a>`state.index` | `bf16`, `f16` | `bf16` | quantizable | Sparse-index key cache. |
| <a id="role-state.kv"></a>`state.kv` | `bf16`, `f16`, `f8e4m3` | `bf16` | quantizable | Storage type of key/value caches.<br>*Note: the cache is the first candidate for quantization* |
| <a id="role-state.recurrent"></a>`state.recurrent` | `f32`, `bf16` | `f32` | full_precision | Fixed-size recurrent state.<br>*Note: a recurrent state accumulates: precision drift compounds in it* |

### Details

**`state.kv`**

The KV cache is the largest growing allocation of a decoder and the first candidate for quantization: `f8e4m3` is admissible, `fp4` is not. The default `bf16` is what a runtime assumes when a state binding selects no dtype.

**`state.recurrent`**

A recurrent state is overwritten at every position and accumulates rounding: `f32` by default, `bf16` admissible, nothing narrower.

<a id="tags" name="tags"></a>

## Tags

Editorial groupings declared by the base manifest; a unit that carries a tag says so in its own section.

<a id="tag-multimodal" name="tag-multimodal"></a>

### `multimodal`

**Crosses a modality boundary: audio or vision into the token stream.**

<a id="tag-parallel-residual" name="tag-parallel-residual"></a>

### `parallel-residual`

**The residual is several parallel streams (§3.5): AltUp, hyper-connections.**

<a id="tag-sequence-operator" name="tag-sequence-operator"></a>

### `sequence-operator`

**Communicates tokens along the sequence and therefore carries state (§4.1).**

Only a sequence operator carries state. Every other primitive is stateless: a runtime needs no allocation strategy for it beyond its parameters and activations.
